versions.changelog:
onepress-deck 3.1.4

- Shortened and clarified the description for the skill.
- Explicitly documents that OnePress video/podcast skills can be invoked after deck creation.
- Minor copyedits for brevity and clarity.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.

onepress-deck 3.1.3

- Added PUBLISHING.md for publishing guidelines.
- Added example asset images for competitive landscape and investor update presentations.
- Updated example markdown files for investor update and market research decks.
- Improved documentation and examples in SKILL.md and CHANGELOG.md.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

onepress-deck 3.1.2

- Expanded support beyond pitch/investor decks to include lessons, research briefings, and narrative/cultural presentations.
- Added account pairing flow: users can now connect to OnePress securely via browser-based authorization (no manual API key copying required).
- Local mode instructions clarified—ask clarifying questions only if it would change the deck outcome; state assumptions otherwise and proceed.
- Connected mode: download finished HTML/PDF/etc. artifact to the user's local directory and report its path.
- Outlined REST endpoints for uploading user files to OnePress tasks.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md; updated documentation and usage examples accordingly.

- Minor update: Documentation and example cleanup.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity and instructions.
- No changes to core functionality or API.

- Minor update with documentation cleanup in SKILL.md; removed redundant details in API usage sections for clarity.
- Example in examples/03-connected-mode.md was updated to better illustrate the connected mode flow.
- skill-card.md file was removed as part of documentation streamlining.
- No changes to local or connected mode behavior; functionality remains the same.
Local mode: builds a real self-contained HTML deck with the bundled recipe — no account needed. Connected mode (API key) delegates to the full OnePress pipeline.
